steps.en: Install the CLI, then start the local dashboard
steps.zh: 装上 CLI，打开本地仪表盘

steps.en: Serves it on 127.0.0.1:4791 from a local SQLite store, so nothing is published
steps.zh: 在本机 127.0.0.1:4791 起工作台，数据只在本地 SQLite

steps.en: Import a git repo and pin the one command that runs an experiment
steps.zh: 导入一个 git 仓库，钉死那条跑实验的命令

steps.en: Create this round's variants as child nodes of the current winner
steps.zh: 把这一轮的几个变体建成当前赢家的子节点

steps.en: Branches one orx/<slug> per node, inheriting the parent's code and fixed command
steps.zh: 每个节点开一条 orx/<slug> 分支，继承父节点的代码与固定命令

steps.en: Edit only that idea's files on the child branch and commit
steps.zh: 在该子分支上只改这个想法的代码并提交

steps.en: Launch the round on the backend you choose
steps.zh: 在你选的后端上启动这一轮

steps.en: Snapshots the commit, runs it there, and keeps the log tied to that run
steps.zh: 把该提交做成快照，在那儿跑，日志绑到这个 run

steps.en: Returns on the first completion, so you can refill the slot or promote the winner
steps.zh: 第一个 run 一结束就返回，你好补位或晋级赢家

value.en: You no longer hand-track which code produced which number: every result carries its commit, log, and artifacts, and the next round builds on the winner
value.zh: 你不用再手工记哪个数字来自哪份代码：每个结果都带着自己的提交、日志和产物，下一轮直接长在赢家上

sources: README.md Get started + CLI integration (curl -LsSf https://openresearch.sh/install.sh | sh; orx up opens 127.0.0.1:4791; orx install-skills; orx projects / runs / logs / exp run / discover / paper; local SQLite store; the SSH remote-mode auth warning)
SKILL.md (orx up owns projects/experiments/runs in a local git repo + local database; orx project edit <projectId> --run-command '<cmd>'; orx create-experiment <projectId> --title '<t>')

agent-skills/orx-experiment-tree/SKILL.md (a project is a tree of experiment nodes: root baseline + fixed run command; orx create-experiment prints the orx/<slug> branch; orx exp run <childId> --backend <b>; orx exp wait --project <projectId> returns on the first completion; frozen-node and identical-command cardinal rules)

agent-skills/orx-create/SKILL.md (import an existing git repo through orx up; the first parentless node is the baseline; a child branches from its parent's branch and inherits its run command; commit before launching because runs use an immutable archive of the local commit)

agent-skills/orx-compute/SKILL.md + references/local.md (each run uses an immutable snapshot of the experiment branch's recorded commit; backends hf / modal / k8s / ssh / slurm / ray / openresearch / tinker / local; local runs share this machine's CPU, RAM and GPU and live under <orx data dir>/local-runs/<runId>/)

SYSTEM_PROMPT.md (the playbook injected into every agent session through each harness's native channel; each session works in its own git worktree of the project; artifacts directory for reports, figures and PDFs)

Cargo.toml + src/ tree (Rust CLI, axum/rust-embed dashboard, bundled rusqlite; src/local/harness/{claude,codex,opencode,cursor,antigravity}.rs; src/local/{slurm,k8s,ray,hf,modal,ssh,localrun}.rs; cargo-dist targets and installers)
